39:1: The sending down of the Book is from Allah, the Mighty, the Possessor of judgment.
39:2: Undoubtedly We sent down to you the Book with truth; so worship Allah, making religion sincere to Him.
39:3: Pay attention, sincere religion belongs to Allah. Those who take protectors besides Him (say): 'We do not worship them except that they may bring us closer to Allah with a bringing near.' Undoubtedly Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Undoubtedly Allah does not guide one who is a liar and ungrateful.
39:4: If Allah had willed to take a child, He would surely have chosen from what He created whatever He willed. He is exalted. He is Allah, the One, the Subduer.
39:5: He created the heavens and the earth with truth. He wraps the night over the day, and wraps the day over the night. He subjected the sun and the moon; each flows until a specified term. Pay attention, He is the Mighty, the Much-Forgiving.
39:6: He created you from a single soul, then made from it its mate, and sent down for you eight pairs of livestock. He creates you in the bellies of your mothers within three darknesses, creation after creation. Here is Allah, your Rabb; the dominion is His. There is no deity except Him. How then are you turned away?
39:7: If you disbelieve, undoubtedly Allah is free of need of you. He is not pleased with disbelief for His servants. If you give thanks, He is pleased with it for you. No bearer of burdens bears the burden of another. Then to your Rabb is your return, and He will inform you of what you used to do. Undoubtedly He is the Knower of what is in the breasts.
39:8: When harm touches man, he prays to his Rabb turning to Him. Then, whenever He bestows a blessing from Himself upon him, he forgets that which he prayed to Him for before, and sets up equals to Allah to mislead from His way. Say: Enjoy your disbelief for a little while; undoubtedly you are of the companions of the fire.
39:9: Or is he who is obedient in the hours of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Rabb? Say: Are those who know and those who do not know equal? Only the possessors of intellect take heed.
39:10: Say: O My servants who believe, fear your Rabb. For those who do good in this world there is goodness. Allah's earth is spacious. The patient will only be paid their reward without account.
39:11: Say: Undoubtedly I have been commanded to worship Allah, making religion sincere to Him.
39:12: And I have been commanded to be the first of the Muslims.
39:13: Say: Undoubtedly I fear, if I disobey my Rabb, the punishment of a great day.
39:14: Say: Making my religion sincere to Him alone, I worship Allah.
39:15: So worship whatever you will besides Him. Say: Undoubtedly the losers are those who bring loss to themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Pay attention, that is the clear loss.
39:16: For them are coverings of fire above them and coverings beneath them. Here is that with which Allah frightens His servants: O My servants, fear Me.
39:17: For those who avoid worshipping Taghut and turn to Allah, there is glad tidings; give glad tidings to My servants.
39:18: Those who listen to the word and follow the best of it; they are those whom Allah has guided, and they are the possessors of intellect.
39:19: Will you rescue from within the fire the one upon whom the word of punishment has become due?
39:20: But for those who fear their Rabb, there are chambers built one above another, beneath which rivers flow. This is Allah's promise. Allah does not fail His promise.
39:21: Did you not see that Allah sent down water from the sky and made it into springs in the earth, then brings forth with it crops of various colors, then it dries and you see it turned yellow, then He turns it into debris? Undoubtedly in this is a reminder for the possessors of intellect.
39:22: Is he whose breast Allah has expanded for Islam, so that he is upon a light from his Rabb? Woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah.
39:23: Allah sent down the best of speech as a book, resembling one another, in pairs. The skins of those who fear their Rabb shiver from it, then their skins and their hearts soften to the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah, He guides with it whom He wills. And whomsoever Allah leads astray, there is no guide for him.
39:24: Is then he who shields himself with his face from the evil of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection? And it was said to the wrongdoers: Taste what you used to earn.
39:25: Those before them also denied, so the punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
39:26: Allah made them taste disgrace in the worldly life, and the punishment of the Hereafter is surely greater, if only they knew.
39:27: And by oath, We have set forth for mankind in this Quran every kind of example, so that perhaps they may take heed.
39:28: An Arabic Quran in which there is no crookedness, so that they may fear.
39:29: Allah gave an example of a man in whom are quarreling partners and a man belonging only to one man. Are these two equal as an example? Praise belongs to Allah. Rather, most of them do not know.
39:30: Undoubtedly you will die, and undoubtedly they will die.
39:31: Then, undoubtedly, on the Day of Resurrection you will dispute in the presence of your Rabb.
39:32: Who is more unjust than one who invents a lie against Allah and denies the truth when it comes to him? Is there not an abode in Hell for the disbelievers?
39:33: And the one who brought the truth and those who confirmed it, they are the ones who fear.
39:34: For them is whatever they will in the presence of their Rabb; that is the reward of the doers of good.
39:35: Allah covers the evils they did and rewards them with the best of what they used to do.
39:36: Is Allah not sufficient for His servant? They frighten you with those besides Him. And whomsoever Allah leads astray, there is no guide for him.
39:37: And whomsoever Allah guides, there is no one to lead him astray. Is Allah not Mighty and Possessor of retribution?
39:38: And by oath, if you ask them who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely say 'Allah.' Say: 'Then have you seen what you worship besides Allah? If Allah willed harm for me, could they remove His harm, or if He willed mercy for me, could they withhold His mercy?' Say: 'Allah is sufficient for me. Upon Him alone let those who rely put their trust.'
39:39: Say: O my people, act according to your position, undoubtedly I too am acting, and soon you will know.
39:40: Upon whom comes a humiliating punishment and upon whom descends a lasting punishment?
39:41: Undoubtedly, We sent down the Book to you for mankind with truth. Whoever is guided, it is for his own benefit, and whoever goes astray, he only goes astray against himself, and you are not a trustee over them.
39:42: Allah takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that have not died, in their sleep. Then He keeps the soul whose death He has decreed, and releases the other until a specified term. Surely in this there are signs for a people who reflect.
39:43: Or have they taken intercessors besides Allah? Say: 'Even if they possess nothing and do not reason?'
39:44: Say: Intercession belongs entirely to Allah. The dominion of the heavens and the earth belongs to Him. Then to Him you will be returned.
39:45: When Allah is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those besides Him are mentioned, they immediately rejoice.
39:46: Say: 'O my Allah, O Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen! You judge between Your servants concerning that wherein they used to differ.'
39:47: If those who do wrong had all that is on the earth and the like of it with it, they would surely offer it as ransom from the evil of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection.
39:48: The evils they have earned will become visible to them, and that which they used to mock will surround them.
39:49: When harm touches man, he prays to Us; then when We grant him a favor from Us, he says: 'This was only given to me because of my knowledge.' Nay, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.
39:50: Those before them had also said it, but the things they had earned did not benefit them.
39:51: Thus the evils they earned struck them. And those who do wrong among these—the evils they earned will strike them too, and they cannot escape.
39:52: Did they not know that Allah expands the provision for whomever He wills and restricts it? Surely in this there are indeed signs for a people who believe.
39:53: Say: O My servants who have exceeded against their own souls! Do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Surely Allah forgives all sins. Surely He is the All-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
39:54: Turn to your Rabb and submit to Him before the punishment comes to you, then you will not be helped.
39:55: Follow the best of what has been sent down to you from your Rabb, before the punishment comes upon you suddenly and while you are not aware.
39:56: Lest a soul should say, 'Woe to me for having exceeded the bounds concerning Allah! Surely I was among those who mocked.'
39:57: Or lest it should say, 'If Allah had guided me, I would surely have been among the people of taqwa.'
39:58: Or lest it should say when it sees the punishment, 'If only there were a return for me, so that I would be among the doers of good.'
39:59: Yes, My signs had come to you, but you denied them, grew arrogant, and were among the disbelievers.
39:60: On the Day of Resurrection you will see the faces of those who lied against Allah turned pitch black; is there not in Hell an abode for the arrogant?
39:61: Allah saves the people of taqwa through their success; evil does not touch them and they will not grieve.
39:62: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is a Trustee over all things.
39:63: The keys of the heavens and the earth belong to Him. Those who disbelieve in the signs of Allah, it is they who are the losers.
39:64: Say: O ignorant ones, do you command me to worship other than Allah?
39:65: And indeed it has been revealed to you and to those before you that if you associate partners, your deed will surely become void and you will surely be among the losers.
39:66: Nay, worship Allah alone and be among the grateful.
39:67: And they did not appraise Allah with true appraisal. On the Day of Resurrection the earth entirely is in His grasp, and the heavens are rolled up in His right hand. Exalted is He and transcendent above what they associate as partners.
39:68: The Sur is blown, so whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth falls dead, except whomever Allah wills. Then it is blown once more; at that time they stand up, looking on.
39:69: The earth shines with the light of its Rabb, the book is set down, the prophets and the witnesses are brought, and it is judged between them with truth.
39:70: Every soul is paid in full for what it did, and He is best aware of what they do.
39:71: Those who disbelieve are driven to Hell in groups. When they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers say to them: "Did there not come to you messengers from among you, reciting to you the signs of your Rabb and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?" They say: "Yes, they came. But the word of punishment has been realized against the disbelievers."
39:72: It is said: "Enter the gates of Hell, to abide therein eternally." How evil is the dwelling place of the arrogant!
39:73: Those who fear their Rabb are driven to Paradise in groups. When they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers say to them: "Peace be upon you, how good you are! Enter it to abide eternally."
39:74: And they say: "Praise be to that Allah Who fulfilled His promise to us and made us inherit the earth, so that we may settle in Paradise wherever we wish; how excellent is the reward of the workers."
39:75: You see the angels surrounding the Arsh, glorifying with the praise of their Rabb. Judgment is made between them with truth, and it is said: 'Praise belongs to Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.'
